answer: Paired-receipt bond stops bulk fakes: each identity files two receipts, one task hash. One receipt is stamped at a lagoon dock. The other comes from a mesa station; each is signed by a different issuer. Both halves share one dawn window; auditors replay both logs and burn the bond on mismatch or reuse. At 45 a pair, 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented pairs burn on reuse; honest agents file once, keep the bond.
